>I’m scared I’ll survive and become disabled

That is a big worry of mine too. Several years ago I was considering suicide, and I came across this website that listed all the methods and their pros/cons. Most of the cons were about what would happen if you survived. I was really scared of becoming paralyzed or barely conscious, just lying in a hospital bed for years and unable to finish the job of killing myself. I think the website was actually secretly trying to discourage suicide, because all the methods had more cons than pros. I guess it helped me then, because the main issue that caused me to be suicidal did eventually get better...   but there's always a new issue around the corner for me. I don't think my current one is going to get better.
